title: Build coverage around the conversation.
intro: Choose the customer conversations your team needs covered, from first response to follow-up. Each role has its own responsibilities, records and escalation rules, so you can add capacity without losing the context behind a request.
caption: People, clear answers and a reliable next step.
groups: Start with the channel where unanswered requests collect. Define which enquiries an assistant can resolve, when to call back and who takes over a sensitive case.
Connect the conversation to the order, appointment or account. A complete note should show what was checked, what was agreed and which person owns the next step.
A service standard you can review
Choose a sample of interactions and agree what good looks like: correct information, clear language, complete notes and an appropriate escalation.
